templates.name: news-article
templates.description: Media release / news article (AEM media-page-template): hero banner with category + title, body text, side navigation. Sampled 20 latest-news, 20 news-archive, 14 check-it-out (newest first).

templates.name: story-article
templates.description: Sustainability story article (AEM content-page-template) under our-stories/<year>/. Sampled the 20 newest stories shown in the Our Stories listing. Also covers the remaining content-page-template our-impact pages with the same structure: older dated stories, podcast landing + episodes (our-stories/podcast/*) and sustainability sub-pages (e.g. human-rights/cotton).

templates.name: story-banner
templates.description: Sustainability story on the AEM stories-page-template: heroBannerCarousel hero, loose one-column body (text, images, pull quotes, videos, CTA buttons) and a three-column 'Related Stories' row of mastercards / video cards.

templates.name: listing-page
templates.description: Pages whose primary content is a DYNAMIC filtered listing of articles (newsArticlesDynamic, latestNewsDynamic, filterTag+contentTile). Listings must be migrated as query-index driven article-list blocks, not static cards.

templates.name: homepage
templates.description: Homepage (source /au/en.html 301 -> /): hero banner carousel, curated content tiles.

templates.name: content-page
templates.description: General landing/content pages (AEM content-page-template). Curated (static) content tiles, ecosystem logo grids, leadership-profile cards. Capped at 20.

templates.name: investor-page
templates.description: Investor pages (AEM media/sub-landing templates): side navigation, link lists of documents, tables, cards.

templates.name: legal-page
templates.description: Privacy, policy and legal statement pages (AEM blank-page-template).

templates.name: leadership-profile
templates.description: Board of directors / management board profile pages (heading, photo, biography; default content only). Sampled 20 CURRENT leaders linked from the listing pages.

templates.name: search-page
templates.description: Site search results page (.wwgsearch). Results are client-rendered from an AEM servlet, so the component becomes a dynamic search block driven by /query-index.json; the tint-sky-10 container becomes the section style.

metadata.title: Search
metadata.description: Search Woolworths Group news, stories, investor information and more.
